description: NakaPunks is a collection of unique digital characters inscribed directly on the Fractal Bitcoin blockchain. Each Punk features a distinctive combination of traits, including body, outfit, hair and headwear, eyes, and mouth. Inspired by cyberpunk aesthetics, Bitcoin culture, and generative art, the collection brings together a diverse range of characters, from classic designs to exceptionally rare combinations. Every inscription represents a unique piece of the NakaPunks universe, permanently preserved on-chain and verifiable by anyone. NakaPunks are digital identities inscribed into the history of Bitcoin.
name: NakaPunks
